About Us

A Hatti-country homestay, three orchards deep

Plum Valley Cottage sits in Hatti country — Tehsil Rajgarh, District Sirmour — just 3 km from Rajgarh town, about three hours from Chandigarh and an hour from Solan. The cottage stands inside a working plum, peach and apricot orchard, and a stay here is as much a window into local Hatti life as it is a retreat.

3 kmfrom Rajgarh town
~1 hrfrom Solan city
~3 hrfrom Chandigarh

Forest trails lead out from the property, the Siana birds point is close by, and the lanes are made for slow cycling. Food is simple and organic, cooked by hosts known for being warm and easygoing.

Simple, slow and close to nature

Plum Valley Cottage is suited to couples, families and small groups looking for an unhurried base near Rajgarh. The page currently provides a phone booking route, so guests can confirm availability and arrangements directly with the hosts.

Where is the cottage?

The cottage is in the Siana forest range near Rajgarh, District Sirmour, Himachal Pradesh, around 3 km from Rajgarh town.

What can I do around the property?

Forest walks, yoga, reading, cycling, birdwatching around Siana Point and enjoying food prepared with local produce are highlighted on this page.
